description: 车对g兵 — 车斜线拦截孤兵

intro.popup_en: Black's g4-pawn is advancing quickly. Bring the rook in front of it along the g-file, cutting off the isolated pawn from support.
intro.popup:
⚠️ 黑g4兵快速推进！
策略：车赶到g线前方，截断兵路，让黑兵孤立无援。

outro.popup_en: The game is decided in just five moves. Quickly transfer the rook in front of the pawn; once the isolated pawn is stopped, it will fall.
outro.popup:
✅ 短短5步完成！
技巧：车迅速转移到兵前方，只要截住孤兵，结果就是必败。

moves.popup_en: The rook enters the game and heads toward the g-file interception point.
Key move: the rook occupies the g-file, leaving the black pawn with no way forward.
moves.popup: ⚡ 关键！车卡在g线，黑兵无路可走！

moves.popup_en: The rook captures the black pawn, leaving White with a large advantage.
